reviews.reason: The mount effect captures mount, fences queued creation with disposed, and owns editorRef for its own one-time editor instance. readyRef is intentionally mutable lifecycle state reset by cleanup, not a DOM node to snapshot. createEditor is the stable vi.hoisted mock constructor captured once by the mock factory; value/onChange updates flow via refs, so adding those values would destroy the editor on typing. The directory-editor Vitest fixture owns a one-time markdown-editor adapter. Mount is captured; disposed fences the queued creation; latest value/onChange are read through refs and cleanup resets readyRef, nulls current editor and destroys that owned instance. createEditor is the vi.hoisted vditorMock.constructor captured when the vi.mock factory evaluates, not a changing prop.
